predictions.source_summary: options.dir comes from external configuration passed to Glance constructor, with default value process.cwd()
predictions.sink_summary: this.dir is used as base directory for file serving: path.join(self.dir, decodeURIComponent(parse(req.url).pathname)) -> fs.stat, fs.createReadStream, fs.exists operations
predictions.guard_summary: Limited guards: nodot option blocks files starting with '.', method restricted to GET, directory indexing optional. No path traversal prevention beyond normalization.
predictions.risk_pattern: External configuration controls base directory for file serving without path traversal protection. Normalization may resolve '..' sequences but doesn't prevent escaping intended directory if attacker controls base path.
predictions.context_summary: Glance constructor normalizes external dir option which becomes base for file serving. User-controlled URL pathname is joined with normalized dir to form fullPath used in file system operations.
unresolved_facts: How options are provided to Glance constructor in actual usage

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
top_sast_rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement path validation using canonical paths. Reject paths containing '../' or similar traversal sequences.
